name: Delivery Return 1 Code
definition: Specifies the type of delivery return.

DQUA.name: Wrong Quantity
DQUA.definition: Wrong quantity delivered in the original instruction.

DMON.name: Wrong Settlement Amount
DMON.definition: Wrong settlement amount settled in the original delivery.

PART.name: Partial Delivery
PART.definition: Only a portion of the original transaction quantity was delivered by the Central Securities Depository (CSD).

SAFE.name: Account Missing
SAFE.definition: Account information is missing in the original delivery.

DUEB.name: Due Biill Missing
DUEB.definition: Due bill information missing in the original delivery.

PARD.name: Partial Return
PARD.definition: Portion of the original transaction quantity was returned by the receiver.
